entries.title: An approved change waiting to merge with others is no longer called stuck
entries.body: When you approve a change in a project that merges approved changes together, or whose main branch has a merge queue, it waits in line until the merge runs. That wait no longer marks the task as stalled, wakes your first mate about it, or raises a card saying it is stuck; its crewmate is told once that nothing is needed while it waits.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new is drawn; the stalled line and the stuck card no longer appear for a change waiting in line.
